problems.text: Two similar vehicles... two different auction houses... two completely different price outcomes.
A car looks like a deal until you realize it was reauctioned three times due to hidden issues
CAP and retail values tell part of the story, but they don’t show actual auction behavior
Inexperienced bidders enter auctions with confidence but leave with regret and thin profit margins.

solution.text: Autoboli changes that by revealing the truths hidden in auction data.
